we present a decentralized multi robot collision avoidance policy that can be learned in a large scale environment with a large number of agents, and that is effective in real world scenarios and can be used for single robot navigation in dense human crowds.

a) a deep reinforcement learning based multi robot collision avoidance policy is able to learn a robust sensor level controller for multi robot navigation in complex scenarios, b) the learned policy is able to generalize to heterogeneous robots and large scale scenarios, and c) the learned policy can be directly applied to the single agent navigation in a dense human crowd.

a) a deep reinforcement learning algorithm can be used to train a fully decentralized policy that is able to handle complex collision avoidance tasks for multi robot systems; b) the proposed multi scenario multi stage learning framework is able to train a collision avoidance policy for a large number of agents in complex environments simultaneously and effectively; c) the learned policy can be deployed on real robots to enable safe and effective navigation in complex environments.

the development of a fully distributed collision avoidance policy for large scale multi robots systems.
the problem of safe navigation of multiple mobile robots in complex environments.
the problem of learning a decentralized sensor level policy for multi robot collision avoidance.
